depth.background: the place, slightly out of focus

questions.camera.angle: From what angle should we see it (low looks powerful, high looks small, eye level is neutral)?
questions.light.direction: Where should the main light come from (behind gives a silhouette edge, the side gives drama, front is flat and clear)?
questions.actors.*.action_state: What is each fighter doing right now (striking, blocking, readying, already hit, falling, dodging)?

staging_rules: Fighters in contact stand on opposite sides of the frame.
A strike is aimed on screen toward the person it hits.
The attacker and the defender have different action states.
The camera stays fixed unless the brief names a move.
